article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya in Brazil: Vaccination and control efforts intensify amid ongoing challenges
article.articleSummary: As of May 5, 2026, Brazil's Mato Grosso do Sul has reported 10,268 probable chikungunya cases, with 4,290 confirmed and 5,978 pending laboratory tests. The outbreak has resulted in 14 deaths across various municipalities, including Dourados and Bonito, affecting 76 out of 79 municipalities, leading to an incidence rate of 351.1 cases per 100,000, significantly higher than the national average of 17.7. The latest epidemiological week saw an increase of 1,295 new probable cases, marking a 17% increase—the largest weekly rise recorded. In response, health authorities in Santos are conducting a Larval Density Assessment to monitor Aedes aegypti populations. Anvisa has authorized Instituto Butantan to manufacture the chikungunya vaccine domestically, transitioning from imported doses previously used to immunize about 23,000 Brazilians. Although outbreaks in the Bororó and Jaguapiru villages have receded, 35 patients remain hospitalized with complications. A community cleanup initiative has collected 250 tons of solid waste to reduce mosquito breeding, and interventions continue under the Incident Action Plan.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのチクングニア熱：継続的な課題の中でワクチン接種と防除対策が強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：14人の死亡と高い発症率、国内の異常な急増、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（高い重症度、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすい環境）。社会的・政治的関心も高い（ワクチン承認、大規模公衆衛生対応）。
triage.notes: ブラジル・マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州での大規模チクングニア熱流行。1週間で1,295例の新規患者（17%増加）、14人の死亡、76/79市町村に波及。Anvisa公認のワクチン国内製造開始など、政府レベルでの重大な対応が進行中。医療システムへの負荷（35人が入院中）と蚊媒介環境制御の重要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Infection in Brazil: Cruise outbreak raises concerns over transmission risks
article.articleSummary: Seven hantavirus cases have been reported aboard the MV Hondius cruise ship, resulting in three fatalities, including two Dutch passengers and one German. The World Health Organization (WHO) is investigating potential human-to-human transmission, as one patient shows severe respiratory symptoms while three others have mild symptoms. The ship, which departed Argentina in March, is currently anchored in international waters off Cape Verde, awaiting disinfection and isolation protocols before docking in the Canary Islands. Historically, Brazil has recorded 2,377 confirmed hantavirus cases and 540 deaths from 1993 to 2024, with 28 cases reported in 2025 and six cases in the first four months of 2026. Symptoms of hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) can escalate from flu-like signs to severe respiratory distress, with no specific antiviral treatment available. Management focuses on supportive care, including oxygen therapy. This outbreak highlights the serious health implications of hantavirus infections in Brazil and the potential for severe complications, particularly as climate change may expand the habitats of rodent carriers.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのハンタウイルス感染：クルーズ船の集団発生が感染リスクについて懸念を高める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当、国際的関心が高い。クルーズ船での集団発生と死亡者、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が確認されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: クルーズ船での集団発生（7例、死亡3例）は異常。記事サマリーではブラジル発生が主題だが、国際水域での隔離と複数国籍患者（オランダ、ドイツ乗客）を含む。WHOによるヒト-ヒト感染調査中。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Brazil: Intensified vaccination and control efforts underway
article.articleSummary: As of early May 2026, Brazil's Piauí state has reported 8,237 dengue cases, with Teresina under a yellow alert due to 2,182 cases. The southern region, particularly São Raimundo Nonato, has seen a significant increase with 1,423 cases, while Simplício Mendes reports over 480 cases, marking a 240% weekly increase. April alone accounted for over 4,000 cases across 28 high-risk municipalities, predominantly affecting individuals aged 20–29. In Santos, health authorities are actively monitoring Aedes aegypti infestation, having eliminated 1,123 larval habitats, with 347 dengue cases reported this year. Concurrently, Mato Grosso do Sul has allocated R$ 855,8 thousand to enhance community health worker efforts in 31 municipalities, addressing rising arboviral diseases, particularly chikungunya, which has resulted in 14 deaths and over 10,000 probable cases. In Paraná, while there has been a substantial drop in cases, health authorities caution against complacency due to the circulation of all four dengue serotypes, with DENV-2 being predominant. Araguaína will end its dengue vaccination campaign for ages 15–59 on May 8, 2026, having delivered about 6,000 doses this year amid its worst outbreak in 14 years.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのデング熱：ワクチン接種と対策の強化が進行中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク）。複数州での大規模流行、死亡報告、多数の患者発生が認められ、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は複数のブラジル州（ピアウイ、マット・グロッソ・ド・スル、パラナ、サンタ・カタリーナ）にわたるデング熱の大規模流行を報告。チクングニヤによる死亡（14件）も報告されており、アルボウイルス感染症全体の懸念が高い。ワクチン接種キャンペーンと幼虫駆除が並行実施されている。2026年5月時点での情報。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Infection in Philippines: Cruise ship outbreak raises urgent health alerts
article.articleSummary: As of May 5, 2026, a hantavirus outbreak linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship has impacted 150 individuals, including 38 Filipinos, resulting in three fatalities. The outbreak, which began between April 6 and April 28, has confirmed two cases and five suspected cases, with symptoms ranging from fever and gastrointestinal issues to severe respiratory complications. In response, strict isolation and hygiene protocols have been enforced, confining passengers to their cabins while medical evacuations to the Canary Islands are underway. The World Health Organization (WHO) has expressed concerns about potential human-to-human transmission following the deaths of a Dutch couple associated with the outbreak. A UK passenger remains in critical condition, and two crew members require urgent medical attention. Despite these developments, WHO assesses the global risk of a large outbreak as low, and investigations into the transmission dynamics are ongoing. Spain has proposed evacuating symptomatic patients and high-risk contacts from the ship, with further actions dependent on Cabo Verde’s epidemiological data.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンでのハンタウイルス感染：クルーズ船の集団発生が緊急の健康警報を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、複数国への波及・死亡事例あり、WHOの懸念表明、渡航・船舶隔離措置実施により、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはフィリピン発のクルーズ船集団発生を主題としており、Bluedot APIの発生地域（Philippines）が正確に反映されている。スペイン領カナリア諸島への医療搬送、スペイン・カーボベルデの対応、オランダ・英国の患者がいるが、イベントの発生地はフィリピン。ハンタウイルスは本来齧歯類由来だが、本記事では人間-人間感染の可能性が指摘されており、クルーズ船という限定された環境での封じ込め対策が進行中。WHOは全球リスクを低と評価しているも、国際的な波及リスクと渡航制限が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in Vietnam: Urgent measures needed to address rising dog bites
article.articleSummary: In early 2026, Vietnam is facing a notable increase in dog and cat bite incidents, raising concerns about potential rabies infections. Lục Yên commune reported 367 cases, while a stray dog in Lam Dong Province attacked 12 individuals, prompting immediate medical responses. All victims received post-exposure prophylaxis, including rabies vaccinations and immunoglobulin treatment. Local health authorities are monitoring the vaccination status of those affected and have initiated public education campaigns to promote responsible pet ownership and vaccination. In Đắk Lắk, six individuals exposed to suspected rabid dogs have also begun receiving vaccinations. The situation underscores the urgent need for enhanced rabies prevention strategies, including stricter oversight of dog ownership and efforts to control stray populations. Recent incidents highlight the critical importance of timely medical intervention, as rabies remains nearly 100% fatal once symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの狂犬病：犬咬傷の増加に対処するための緊急措置が必要
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はIHR通知対象疾患であり、ベトナムで咬傷事例の顕著な増加が報告されている。複数地域での集中発生（ルックイエン地区367例、ラムドン省12例、ダクラク省6例）と致死性疾患の特性により、IHR基準2項目以上を満たし、シグナルとしてピックアップすべき案件である。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率ほぼ100%の疾患。記事は複数地域での咬傷事例増加とワクチン接種対応状況を報告。地域当局による監視・啓発活動が既に展開されている。野犬管理と飼い主教育の強化が重要課題として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Measles in Indonesia: Intensified vaccination efforts amid widespread outbreaks
article.articleSummary: In Indonesia, measles cases are escalating, with 63,769 suspected cases reported in 2025, including 11,095 confirmed cases and 69 deaths, resulting in a case fatality rate of 0.1%. As of week 7 in 2026, there are 8,224 suspected cases, 572 confirmed cases, and 4 deaths, indicating a case fatality rate of 0.05%. Outbreaks are widespread, affecting 17 regencies and cities across 11 provinces, prompting a Public Health Emergency in Central Java due to 2,188 suspected cases. Authorities are implementing Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) campaigns to achieve at least 95% immunization coverage. In Cimahi City, West Java, 237 suspected cases have been reported, with 28 laboratory-confirmed positives, primarily among children lacking complete immunization. The Health Department has intensified vaccination efforts and community education to reinforce hygiene practices. In Cirebon Regency, the local government guarantees free treatment for measles cases at public hospitals, reporting 119 suspected cases and 23 laboratory-confirmed positives as of May 5, 2026, with ongoing public education and vaccination expansion efforts.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの麻疹：広範囲なアウトブレイクの中での予防接種強化活動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ満たし（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大のリスク、異常性），多数の死亡と確認症例が報告されており，複数州にまたがる広域流行を示している。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシア全土での麻疹流行を記述しており，11州17地域に及ぶ広域アウトブレイクを示している。2025年の累計11,095確認症例，69死亡，2026年初期での4死亡が報告されており，特に完全予防接種を受けていない小児が主要な被影響集団である。当局による公衆衛生緊急事態宣言とORI（アウトブレイク対応予防接種）キャンペーンの実施により，政府レベルでの対応が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Infection in China: Public health measures intensify amid rising cases
article.articleSummary: As of May 5, 2026, China has reported over 150,000 hantavirus cases, accounting for more than half of the global annual total. A recent outbreak linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship has resulted in three deaths and one confirmed case, with five additional suspected cases under WHO monitoring. The Seoul virus strain, associated with brown rats, poses significant risks, especially in rodent-exposed areas. Symptoms typically manifest 1-2 weeks post-exposure, resembling flu-like conditions, and current treatment remains supportive due to the absence of a specific cure. Public health authorities are emphasizing rapid case investigation, contact tracing, and rodent control measures. The Shanghai CDC is advising travelers returning from affected regions to maintain hygiene and seek medical evaluation if symptoms arise. Additionally, concerns are growing regarding the Andes hantavirus, which has shown potential for person-to-person transmission, as evidenced by a recent outbreak aboard the MV Hondius, prompting quarantine measures for over 140 passengers and crew.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でのハンタウイルス感染：症例増加に伴い公衆衛生対策が強化
triage.triage_reason: 中国で15万例以上の大規模ハンタウイルス集団発生が報告され、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念が生じている。IHR基準（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）の複数該当に加え、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性を含むWPRO基準複数項目に該当するため、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは中国での大規模ハンタウイルス集団発生を主題としており、発生地域フィールドのChinaと一致。MV Hondius船の事例を含む国際的な拡大、Andesハンタウイルスによるヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、および150,000例以上の症例数はすべてIHR通知基準を満たす。WHOの監視対象案件として扱う必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Infection in Vietnam: Urgent health warnings issued following cruise ship outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of May 5, 2026, Vietnam's Ministry of Health reported a hantavirus cluster linked to a Dutch-flagged cruise ship, resulting in three fatalities among seven identified cases. The outbreak includes two confirmed infections and five suspected cases, with one patient in critical condition. The cruise ship, which carried 147 individuals from 23 nationalities, did not have any Vietnamese nationals on board. Hantavirus, primarily transmitted through rodent excretions, poses significant health risks, including severe respiratory illness. The Ministry has issued urgent warnings and preventive measures, advising the public to avoid contact with rodents and to maintain proper hygiene practices. Symptoms can manifest within 2 to 8 weeks, and there is no specific antiviral treatment available, making supportive care essential. The World Health Organization has assessed the outbreak as low risk for community spread, emphasizing the importance of hygiene and seeking medical attention for symptoms following potential exposure.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのハンタウイルス感染：クルーズ船アウトブレイク後に緊急保健警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスの集団発生により3名の死亡者が報告されており、IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常/予想外」に該当。スクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡3名）と異常性が確認される。
triage.notes: クルーズ船由来のアウトブレイクで多国籍乗客（23ヶ国）が関係し、国際的拡大リスクが存在。WHOは現時点で「低リスク」評価だが、進行中の状況監視が必要。死亡率が高い（3/7症例で43%）点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1 in India: Containment efforts and public health measures underway
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza has been confirmed in Karnataka's Tumakuru district, resulting in the death of over 44 peafowls and mynah birds between April 16 and 21. Following validation by the Indian Council of Agricultural Research-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (ICAR-NIHSAD) on April 29, a containment zone (0–3 km) and a surveillance zone (3–10 km) were established, impacting 38 villages and around 20,000 residents. Health authorities are urging the public to avoid contact with sick or dead birds and to maintain hygiene. In Maharashtra's Navapur, nearly 200,000 chickens have been culled due to an outbreak, with 807,922 eggs destroyed and 21.22 metric tonnes of poultry feed discarded. ICAR-NIHSAD confirmed positive samples from four farms, leading to strict biosecurity measures and the deployment of 25 rapid response teams. This marks Navapur's third avian influenza outbreak, with ongoing monitoring and public health initiatives to mitigate risks.

triage.headline_ja: インド におけるトリ インフルエンザA型H5N1の人間感染：封じ込め努力と公衆衛生対策が進行中
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザがインドで確認され、大規模な家禽の殺処分と複数州での感染が報告されている。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生への影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク、およびWPRO基準で重症度・管理可能性が該当し、シグナルとしてピックアップが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはカルナタカ州トゥムクル地区、マハラシュトラ州ナヴァプル、マディヤプラデシュ州ボパールでのH5N1確認を詳述。Bluedotの発生地域フィールドはこれら3州すべてを含み、サマリーが複数州での感染を確認しているため、インド全体が verified_locations に含まれる。大規模な家禽殺処分（マハラシュトラだけで約20万羽）、複数州での拡大、約20,000人の住民が監視区域に含まれるなど、国内の複数地域での継続的なアウトブレイク。人獣共通感染症のハイリスク病原体であり、国際的な貿易制限および渡航制限のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in Brazil: Vaccination efforts intensify amid recent fatalities
article.articleSummary: In April 2026, Brazil faced a significant rabies outbreak affecting both livestock and humans, particularly linked to vampire bats in Tiradentes do Sul. This prompted immediate public health responses, including a vaccination campaign initiated on June 5, 2026, targeting livestock within a 10 km radius. A recent human rabies case in Oeiras, Piauí, resulted in the death of a 17-year-old, raising alarms and leading the State Program for Control of Rabies in Herbivores (Adapi) to issue warnings for increased vigilance among farmers and residents. Symptoms to monitor include excessive drooling and motor incoordination in animals. Authorities are urging the vaccination of cattle, goats, sheep, and horses, while advising against contact with suspected rabid animals. Emergency measures are also in effect in Mato Grosso due to confirmed bovine rabies cases. Community cooperation is crucial to prevent further spread and protect public health, with ongoing monitoring and public awareness campaigns being emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの狂犬病：最近の死亡者の中でワクチン接種努力が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、異常性）。WPRO基準でも複数該当（重症度、流行性、長期曝露）。人畜共通感染症で死亡事例あり。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないが、IHR基準3つ以上及びWPRO基準複数該当により、シグナルとしてピックアップ。2026年4月の大規模アウトブレイク、吸血コウモリ関連、17歳死亡事例、複数州での広がり（Tiradentes do Sul、Oeiras Piauí、Mato Grosso）。家畜と人間両方に影響。緊急のワクチン接種キャンペーン実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Avian Influenza in India: Emergency measures implemented to control outbreaks
article.articleSummary: An avian influenza outbreak in Nawapur district has led to emergency measures, including a ban on chicken and egg sales. Approximately 44,000 birds have been culled within two days, with plans to destroy an additional 140,000 chickens to prevent further spread. The poultry industry is facing significant financial losses, estimated at 5 million rupees daily, alongside the wastage of 20,000 eggs and 44 tons of poultry feed. In Karnataka's Tumakuru district, H5N1 was confirmed after the deaths of over 44 peafowls, prompting the establishment of infection and surveillance zones covering 38 villages and monitoring around 20,000 residents. While human cases are rare, symptoms can mimic flu and may lead to severe respiratory issues. Public health officials stress the importance of avoiding contact with infected birds, maintaining hygiene, and thoroughly cooking poultry. Ongoing vigilance and public cooperation are essential in managing the outbreak and ensuring community safety.

triage.headline_ja: インドにおける鳥インフルエンザ：発生抑制のための緊急措置の実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数州での大規模な畜産被害、H5N1確認、人間への感染リスク、および広域監視体制の構築が確認されている。
triage.notes: マハラシュトラ州ナワプール地区およびカルナタカ州トゥマクル地区での鳥インフルエンザ発生。H5N1確認済み。44,000羽の焼却、さらに140,000羽の処分計画。農業・経済への重大な影響（日額500万ルピーの損失）。38村をカバーする感染・監視ゾーン設置、約20,000人の住民が監視対象。人間への感染例は稀だが、呼吸器系合併症のリスクがあり、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza in Brazil: Vaccination efforts intensified amid rising cases
article.articleSummary: As of May 2026, Brazil is experiencing a significant increase in influenza cases, with approximately 5,500 Severe Acute Respiratory Illness (SARI) cases reported and 352 deaths attributed to the virus. In response, health authorities have extended care hours at facilities like UBS Central in Canela to manage the influx of patients, particularly during the evening hours. Vaccination campaigns are being reinforced, targeting vulnerable populations such as children, pregnant women, and the elderly, with a goal of achieving 90% coverage. In Rio Preto, three deaths from Influenza A (H3N2) have been confirmed, alongside 57 SARI cases. Meanwhile, Pernambuco is facing a critical situation with 52 children and seven newborns awaiting ICU beds due to respiratory illnesses. The state has opened 330 new ICU beds to accommodate the demand and is actively monitoring the epidemiological situation. Vaccination efforts are ongoing, with over 554,000 doses administered, but coverage remains below target levels.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのインフルエンザ：増加する症例の中で予防接種の取り組みを強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：5,500SARI症例・352死亡、異常・予想外の増加、国内複数州での拡大傾向）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（重症度あり、流行しやすさあり、管理可能性への言及）。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル全体（特にサンパウロ州とペルナンブーコ州）でのインフルエンザ増加を報告。5,500SARI症例、352死亡、複数州での病床不足、予防接種キャンペーン拡大など、深刻な公衆衛生事象として確認される。2026年5月時点でのリアルタイム対応事例。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya in India: Travelers face health risks from returning cases
article.articleSummary: In 2024, Chikungunya has become a notable health concern for travelers, with 112 confirmed or probable cases reported among those returning to the UK, a 50% increase from the previous year. India is identified as the primary source of these cases, alongside Pakistan and Brazil. Symptoms include high fever and severe joint pain, with most patients recovering within 1-2 weeks, although some may experience prolonged joint pain. Serious complications are rare, occurring in about 1 in 1,000 cases. Preventive measures focus on avoiding mosquito bites and eliminating standing water, as there is no specific antiviral treatment available. Meanwhile, Delhi has reported 5 chikungunya cases this year, amidst a larger dengue outbreak with 107 cases recorded, primarily due to erratic rainfall that promotes mosquito breeding. Civic authorities have intensified vector control efforts, including extensive house visits and legal actions against breeding sites, highlighting the ongoing challenges in managing mosquito-borne diseases.

triage.headline_ja: インドのチクングニア熱：帰国患者からの健康リスク
triage.triage_reason: インドでのチクングニア熱の確認と帰国患者による国際的拡大（英国への輸入例112件、前年比50%増）があり、IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」および「渡航制限リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「流行しやすさ」と「異常性」が認識される。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Indonesia: Strategies and community efforts to combat outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of April 30, 2026, Indonesia has reported 244 dengue fever cases, with the Bangko District experiencing the highest incidence at 35 cases. Tragically, three deaths have been recorded. Local health officials, including Maria Susanti from the Rohil Health Office, noted an increase in cases but have not declared a dengue outbreak emergency. The total cases in 2025 were 364, indicating a potential rise in 2026. A meeting on May 5, 2026, focused on prevention strategies, emphasizing environmental cleanliness and vector control, with community participation deemed essential. Unsettled weather and rising temperatures have led to year-round dengue risk, particularly affecting individuals aged 5–44, with the highest mortality rate among 5–14-year-olds. An integrated prevention approach is necessary, including environmental control, community awareness, and vaccination, which is now recommended for children aged 4–18 following recent approvals. The Indonesian Health Ministry reports that dengue cases have nearly tripled over the last five years, with efforts aimed at eliminating dengue deaths by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのデング熱：アウトブレイク対策のための戦略とコミュニティの取り組み

triage.notes: インドネシアではデング熱が5年間でほぼ3倍に増加しており、2026年も増加傾向が懸念される。3名の死亡例あり、特に5～14歳の小児で死亡率が高い。インドネシア保健省は2030年までのデング熱死亡ゼロを目標とした統合的予防対策を展開中。気候変動と温度上昇により年間を通じたリスクが継続。

article.articleHeadline: Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome in China: Public health strategies and recent outbreak concerns
article.articleSummary: Hemorrhagic Fever with Renal Syndrome (HFRS) poses a significant public health challenge in China, contributing to over half of the estimated 150,000 global cases each year. The disease, primarily transmitted through rodent excretions, can lead to severe complications such as hypotension, internal bleeding, and acute kidney failure. Recent incidents, including three deaths linked to hantavirus on the MV Hondius cruise, highlight the risks associated with confined environments. Surveillance data indicates that from 1993 to 2023, the United States reported 890 cases, with the Seoul virus being a notable strain. Currently, there are no specific antiviral treatments available, making supportive care essential for affected individuals. Prevention strategies focus on minimizing rodent exposure and improving sanitation, particularly in travel settings, to mitigate transmission risks. The ongoing challenges emphasize the urgent need for effective public health interventions to manage and reduce the impact of HFRS.

triage.headline_ja: 中国におけるハンタウイルス肺症候群：公衆衛生戦略と最近の流行懸念

triage.notes: HFRSはげっ歯類由来の既知感染症であり、中国では風土病である。ただし、最近の巡洋船での死亡事例（MV Hondius）と年150,000例の全球的負担、治療法の欠如、閉鎖環境での伝播リスク拡大が懸念材料。記事は公式サーベイランスデータ（1993-2023年）を参照し、信頼性がある。

In Sergipe, the Laboratório Central de Saúde Pública has confirmed the circulation of the H3N2 variant subclade K, associated with an uptick in influenza-like illnesses across the country. This variant has been detected in nearly all Brazilian states, prompting health officials to stress the importance of vaccination and symptom monitoring. Vaccination is currently available for priority groups in 75 municipalities in Sergipe, aiming to reduce severe disease and hospitalizations.

article.articleHeadline: Mpox in Brazil: Current cases and transmission patterns highlighted
article.articleSummary: As of 2026, Brazil has reported 215 confirmed mpox cases, contributing to a total of 784 cases in the Americas during Weeks 1-13. The majority of cases are among men aged 29-43, reflecting similar trends in Argentina. The prevalent clade in Brazil is Ib, with some cases identified as clade I. Mpox spreads through direct contact, including sexual transmission, and typically presents with symptoms such as skin lesions, fever, and lymphadenopathy. While the disease is generally self-limiting, it poses higher risks for immunocompromised individuals and pregnant women. Co-infections with other sexually transmitted infections are common, highlighting the need for increased awareness and preventive measures among at-risk populations. Recently, Espírito Santo confirmed its fifth case of mpox, indicating ongoing transmission. Individuals exhibiting symptoms are urged to seek healthcare promptly to facilitate early identification and management.

article.articleHeadline: Rabies in India: Urgent action required to prevent further fatalities
article.articleSummary: Gwalior, India, is facing a critical rabies outbreak, with eight infections and seven deaths reported in just three months. The latest victim, Raju Kushwaha, succumbed after receiving inadequate medical care post-dog bite, highlighting severe healthcare shortcomings. From December 2025 to April 2026, Gwalior recorded 13,579 dog-bite incidents, leading to thousands seeking treatment. The World Health Organization emphasizes that rabies is preventable, yet it remains nearly always fatal once symptoms manifest. In Jammu and Kashmir, dog bite cases have surged to over 206,000 from 2024 to 2025, averaging about 282 cases daily. The Jammu division accounted for 61% of these cases, with Jammu district alone reporting 76,824 incidents. Efforts are underway, including Animal Birth Control and Anti-Rabies Vaccination programs, to mitigate rabies risk, particularly near schools and hospitals. Immediate enhancements in vaccination and treatment protocols are essential to avert further tragedies.

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Infection in Philippines: Monitoring efforts intensify following cruise ship outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of May 6, 2026, a hantavirus outbreak linked to the MV Hondius cruise ship has resulted in three fatalities and multiple infections. The ship, carrying around 147 individuals from various nationalities, has been under health scrutiny after a Dutch couple and a German passenger succumbed to the virus. The World Health Organization is investigating the outbreak, with the Andes virus suspected as the cause. The Philippines' Department of Health is prepared to test 38 Filipino crew members aboard the vessel for hantavirus if they are repatriated, although they currently remain asymptomatic and in quarantine. Local laboratories are equipped to conduct the necessary tests. Approximately 80 individuals have been traced as potentially exposed due to a passenger's travel by plane. The situation is being closely monitored, with no confirmed hantavirus cases reported in the Philippines this year.

article.articleHeadline: Vibrio Vulnificus Infection in China: Critical cases highlight urgent need for public awareness
article.articleSummary: Recent reports from Shanghai indicate a troubling trend in Vibrio vulnificus infections, particularly among individuals handling seafood. A severe case involved a 70-year-old woman who developed symptoms within 24 hours of a puncture wound, leading to rapid deterioration and necessitating extensive medical intervention. Despite aggressive treatment, including surgical debridement and tailored antibiotics, the infection's aggressive nature poses a significant risk, especially for those with underlying health conditions. Another case involved an elderly man who suffered a fatal outcome after a minor injury from a blue crab, illustrating the high mortality rate associated with untreated infections. These incidents emphasize the critical need for heightened public awareness and timely medical responses to prevent severe outcomes from Vibrio vulnificus infections in China.

article.articleHeadline: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Infection in Brazil: Vaccination efforts intensify amid rising respiratory cases

The Health Ministry continues to adapt vaccine strategies to combat ongoing viral mutations, emphasizing the importance of immunization in reducing hospitalizations.

The focus remains on preventing water accumulation to mitigate the risks associated with both malaria and dengue.

A mass vaccination campaign initiated by the Ministry of Health on April 21, 2026, aims to curb the outbreak, especially among children under five, who are the most vulnerable. The campaign will integrate measles and polio vaccinations, with emergency teams deployed in Bokonzi to enhance outreach and vaccination efforts. The urgency of the situation is underscored by the high incidence of measles among malnourished children, necessitating immediate action to prevent further fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の麻疹：ワクチン接種キャンペーンの強化により進行中の流行に対抗
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRC国内での急速な麻疹流行（4,189例、71人死亡）、栄養不良児の高い重症化率、サブサハラ地域での国際拡大リスク、公衆衛生システムへの脅威が明確。
triage.notes: 2026年2月18日に流行宣言、Sud-Ubangi地域で1,478例（184例は栄養不良児）、全16保健地域で累計4,189例・71人死亡。MSFが治療と予防接種支援に参加。栄養不良児における重症化率が高く、緊急対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in Democratic Republic of the Congo: Integrated health response amid ongoing health crises
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) has treated over 2,192 malaria cases among children under five in Karawa since March 30, 2026. This surge in malaria cases coincides with a significant measles outbreak, which has reported 4,189 cases and 71 deaths across the province since January. The Ministry of Health has initiated a mass vaccination campaign starting April 21, 2026, to combat the measles epidemic, which has also affected malnourished children, with 184 cases reported. MSF is actively involved in vaccination and community outreach efforts in the hardest-hit areas, emphasizing the need for an integrated health response to address both malaria and measles effectively. Emergency teams have been deployed in Bokonzi since late January 2026 to curb transmission, highlighting the vulnerability of young children in this ongoing health crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のマラリア：進行中の健康危機の中での統合的保健対応
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5歳未満児2,192人以上のマラリア患者が報告され、麻疹アウトブレイク（4,189例、71死亡）と同時発生。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、IHR基準2項目以上該当、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリアを疾患名としているが、サマリーの記述では麻疹アウトブレイク（4,189例、71死亡）が主要な健康危機であり、マラリア患者2,192例と同時発生している状況。複合的な公衆衛生危機。MSFが対応中で国際的支援の可視化あり。

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal Meningitis in Brazil: Vaccination campaigns bolster community protection efforts
article.articleSummary: In the first four months of 2026, Cuiabá reported seven confirmed cases of meningitis, resulting in three deaths, with an incidence rate of 1.01 per 100,000, below the national average of 1.4. Most cases are attributed to non-meningococcal causes, including viral and bacterial infections. The affected demographics include infants, adults, and the elderly, with transmission primarily through respiratory droplets and contaminated food or water. Symptoms include high fever, severe headache, and gastrointestinal distress, with severe cases showing neurological signs. Despite the fatalities, the municipal Health Secretariat considers the situation epidemiologically normal. In response, vaccination efforts are being intensified, with meningitis vaccines available at 72 Family Health Units in Cuiabá. Additionally, two suspected cases in Rolim de Moura, Rondônia, are under investigation, with laboratory results pending. The Municipal Health Secretariat emphasizes the importance of vaccination and encourages residents to keep their vaccination cards updated as a preventive measure against meningitis.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in China: Trends in transmission and imported cases analyzed
article.articleSummary: From 2005 to 2025, China documented 148,893 dengue cases, with 90.1% being indigenous and 9.9% imported. The majority of imported cases occur between May and June, leading to local transmission peaking in late summer and autumn. The sources of imported infections have expanded from 9 countries in 2005 to 52 by 2025, with Cambodia and Myanmar being significant contributors. High-risk areas for local transmission include Yunnan and Guangdong, with Yunnan linked to Myanmar and Guangdong to multiple sources. Recent reports from Tainan City in Taiwan indicate an increase in imported cases, with a woman in her 30s confirmed after returning from the Maldives. The Dengue Prevention Center has initiated emergency responses, including vector control measures. Health officials stress the importance of timely reporting and travel history documentation to mitigate community spread.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のデング熱：伝播傾向と輸入症例の分析
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の流行が確認されており、複数国からの輸入症例と地域伝播が報告されているが、記事は主に過去20年の分析と傾向把握に焦点を当てており、現在の緊急事態の詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は2005～2025年の20年間のデング熱流行分析であり、現在の急性イベント情報というより流行傾向分析である。しかし、江蘇省のGuanmiaoでの最近の症例報告、台湾・台南市での輸入症例増加報告が含まれており、現在進行形の輸入症例圧力が存在することが示唆される。ミャンマーやカンボジアからの輸入症例が継続的に報告されており、雲南省と広東省における地域伝播リスクが評価されている。詳細な現在の症例数・死亡数、重症度情報は記事に示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus Syndrome in China: Public health measures intensify amid rising cases
article.articleSummary: As of April 2023, China is facing a significant increase in enterovirus cases, particularly due to Coxsackie A16. Outpatient visits have surged, with neighboring Vietnam reporting over 34,400 cases and eight fatalities. Taiwan is also experiencing a peak in enterovirus activity, with 3,814 outpatient visits last week and four severe cases linked to EV-D68 this year. Public health officials are emphasizing the importance of preventive measures, including rigorous hand hygiene and environmental disinfection, as the peak season approaches. Recommendations highlight the use of chlorine-based cleaning solutions for effective sanitation against enteroviruses. The situation remains fluid, with ongoing surveillance and advisories aimed at controlling the spread of the virus, which poses a higher risk to children under five. Warning signs such as drowsiness and limb weakness necessitate prompt medical attention.

triage.headline_ja: エンテロウイルス症候群の中国での流行：症例増加に伴い公衆衛生措置が強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。実在する地域感染症イベントとして優先評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は中国、ベトナム、台湾を言及しているが、対象国リストではChina(1814991)のみが該当。ベトナムとの国境を越えた感染事例報告（ベトナムで34,400症例以上）があり、国際的拡大の具体的な証拠がある。エンテロウイルス（特にコクサッキーA16とEV-D68）による児童への高リスク、複数の死亡例報告。公衆衛生当局による能動的対応と監視体制が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus 71 in Vietnam: Public health response amid significant case counts
article.articleSummary: Vietnam has reported over 34,400 cases of Enterovirus 71, with eight fatalities as of April. The outbreak is primarily affecting Ho Chi Minh City and surrounding southern provinces, marking a critical public health issue. Currently, the country is in the peak season for enterovirus infections, prompting health authorities to stress the importance of hygiene practices to curb further transmission. Recommendations include keeping ill children at home, rigorous hand hygiene, and using effective disinfectants, as alcohol does not work against enteroviruses. Public health officials are closely monitoring the situation and urging communities to remain vigilant and proactive in their response to this ongoing outbreak. Additionally, neighboring countries are experiencing rising enterovirus activity, with Taiwan reporting four critical cases and similar trends noted in China and Singapore.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのエンテロウイルス71：多くの症例数の中での公衆衛生対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。ベトナムで34,400以上の症例と8例の死亡を報告。台湾・中国・シンガポールでも活動上昇が報告されており、地域的な懸念。
triage.notes: ベトナムで34,400以上の確認症例と8例の死亡。ホーチミン市と南部州での局地的集中。ピークシーズン中で継続中。台湾で4例の重症例、中国とシンガポールでも上昇活動が報告されている。東南アジアでの地域的懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Vietnam: Ongoing transmission and preventive measures emphasized
article.articleSummary: In 2026, Vietnam has reported 224 dengue fever cases year-to-date, with no fatalities. Recent data from Hanoi indicates 4 new cases within the last week, highlighting the need for continued vigilance. The country is facing challenges with imported cases, as evidenced by Taiwan's report of 50 dengue cases linked to travelers from Vietnam, Indonesia, and the Maldives. This situation underscores the importance of travel history awareness among healthcare providers to mitigate transmission risks. Local health authorities in Vietnam are responding with emergency fogging and vector control measures, especially with the rainy season approaching and El Niño conditions expected to exacerbate mosquito breeding. Residents are urged to manage potential breeding sites actively. Additionally, Hanoi has reported a decrease in hand, foot and mouth disease cases, with 179 new cases in the past week, indicating ongoing public health challenges that require strict surveillance and enhanced sanitation efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのデング熱：継続的な感染伝播と予防措置の強調
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのデング熱の継続的伝播が確認され、台湾への輸入症例が報告されており、国際的な拡大リスクが顕在化している。IHR基準で異常性・国際的拡大リスクに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 2026年のデング熱症例は224例（死亡なし）だが、ハノイでの週間4新規症例と台湾への輸入症例（50例）が確認されている点が重要。雨季到来とエルニーニョ条件による蚊媒介リスク増加を指摘。国際的な拡大監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Foot And Mouth Disease in Vietnam: Enhanced measures to control disease spread
article.articleSummary: As of May 5, 2026, Vietnam's General Department of Customs has intensified controls to prevent the spread of foot-and-mouth disease virus (FMDV). Following directives from the Prime Minister, the department is focusing on surveillance and inspections of imports and exports, particularly concerning the emerging FMDV serotype SAT1. This serotype poses a significant risk due to low immunity in local cattle populations. Currently, Vietnam is managing serotypes O and A, with strict penalties for violations related to animal smuggling. In Hanoi, from April 24 to May 1, 2026, there were 179 reported cases of hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD), a decrease from the previous week. Cumulatively, 2,696 HFMD cases have been recorded in 2026, with 58 outbreaks, six of which remain active. Authorities emphasize the need for strict surveillance, especially in schools, and encourage parents to seek medical attention for severe symptoms to prevent complications.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムの口蹄疫：疾病拡大を制御するための強化措置
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける口蹄疫（FMD）の公式な制御措置強化が報告されており、新しいSAT1血清型の出現と家畜集団の免疫低下による国際的リスクが認識されている。IHR基準（異常性、国際拡大リスク）とWPRO基準（重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性）に複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムにおける口蹄疫の新しいSAT1血清型の出現と公式な制御措置強化を報告。首相の指示に基づいた通関強化、輸出入検査、家畜密輸厳罰化が実施されている。同じ記事内でハノイのHFMD（手足口病）データも報告されているが、これは別疾患。口蹄疫は家畜疾病として国際貿易への影響が大きく、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重要シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Philippines: Emergency measures and prevention efforts underway
article.articleSummary: In 2026, the Philippines has been identified as a significant source of imported dengue cases, with Taiwan reporting 50 such cases, including a recent instance involving a woman from Tainan City who contracted the virus after traveling to the Maldives. Local health authorities in Taiwan have responded by implementing emergency fogging and vector control measures to curb the spread. The Dengue Prevention Center is urging clinicians and the public to be vigilant about travel histories to reduce transmission risks, especially with the approaching rainy season and El Niño conditions. Meanwhile, in Argentina's San Cristóbal Department, dengue prevention supplies have been distributed to enhance local control efforts. Officials reported only one recent case linked to travel, highlighting the importance of rapid local interventions to prevent further outbreaks. The department has been proactive, being the first to initiate dengue vaccination and to receive essential supplies for fumigation and prevention, underscoring the need for coordinated actions across municipalities to combat the disease effectively.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピンのデング熱：緊急対策と予防活動が進行中
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンからの輸入デング熱症例が台湾で報告されており、国際的な拡散リスクが示唆されているが、フィリピン国内の詳細な患者数・死亡数などの重症度情報が不明確。情報の充実を待つ必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは台湾とアルゼンチンでの対応を多く記載しているが、イベントの主体はフィリピンからの輸入デング症例である。フィリピン国内の流行規模・患者数・重症度に関する具体的情報が不足しており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」の判断が困難。雨季とエルニーニョ条件により流行拡大リスクは存在。ベクター対策が進行中と記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Avian Influenza in India: Containment efforts amid confirmed H5N1 cases
article.articleSummary: H5N1 avian influenza has been confirmed in Karnataka's Tumakuru district, following the deaths of over 44 peafowls between April 16 and 21. The Indian Council of Agricultural Research-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (ICAR-NIHSAD) confirmed the virus on April 29, prompting the establishment of a containment zone extending 0–3 km and a surveillance zone of 3–10 km, impacting around 20,000 residents across 38 villages. While human cases remain rare, symptoms can mimic flu, including fever, cough, and body aches, potentially escalating to severe respiratory issues. Infections typically arise from direct contact with infected birds or contaminated environments, with limited human-to-human transmission reported. Authorities advise the public to avoid contact with sick or deceased birds, practice good hygiene, and ensure poultry is well-cooked. Continuous monitoring and public health measures are in place to mitigate the risk of human infection.

triage.headline_ja: インドにおけるヒトへの鳥インフルエンザ感染：確定H5N1症例の中での封じ込め努力
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザがインド・カルナタカ州で確認され、IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）に該当。WPRO基準も複数該当し、公開情報での報道開始により社会的関心が生じている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはカルナタカ州トゥマクル地区での孔雀死亡（44羽以上）に伴うH5N1確認を報じており、約20,000名の住民が影響を受ける広がりを示唆。ヒト-ヒト感染は限定的と記述されているが、ウイルスの異常性、重症呼吸器疾患への進行可能性、約3週間の封じ込め帯設定により公衆衛生上の懸念は顕著。インドは対象国リストに含まれ検証済み。

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal Meningitis in Thailand: Public health measures urged amid ongoing outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed cases of meningococcal meningitis have been reported in Taiwan, involving a one-month-old infant and a man in his 30s who traveled to Thailand and Malaysia. The adult developed symptoms after returning from his trip and was hospitalized on May 1 after self-medicating. One of his close contacts, a foreign national, has since left Taiwan and is under monitoring until May 9. The disease is transmitted through respiratory droplets and close contact, with higher risks for individuals with compromised immunity. Symptoms include fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, and nausea, with severe cases potentially leading to coma or sepsis. Public health officials emphasize the importance of seeking prompt medical care, reporting travel history, practicing good hygiene, and avoiding crowded places to mitigate the spread of the disease.

triage.headline_ja: タイにおける髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎：進行中の流行の中での公衆衛生対策の強化が求められる
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はタイでの流行を述べているが、実際の確認症例はタイワン（台湾）で報告されており、タイでの確認症例の有無が明記されていない。地域検証で判定に不確実性があるため、追加情報待機が適切。
triage.notes: 見出しはタイでの流行を示唆しているが、記事サマリーの主要な確認症例はタイワン（台湾）で報告されており、タイワンは対象国リストに含まれていない。サマリー上でタイでの実際の確認症例の報告がなく、旅行履歴に基づくリスク言及のみであるため、verified_locations は空配列とした。タイでの実際の患者報告の有無を確認する追加情報が必要である。

article.articleHeadline: Meningococcal Meningitis in Vietnam: Public health measures urged amid ongoing outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Vietnam is currently experiencing cases of meningococcal meningitis, with global outbreaks reported in various regions including Africa, Japan, and North America. Recent developments highlight the importance of public health measures as two confirmed cases were reported in Taiwan, linked to travel in Southeast Asia. Symptoms of meningococcal meningitis include fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, and nausea, with severe cases potentially leading to coma or sepsis. Health experts emphasize the need for prompt medical attention, especially for individuals with recent travel or close contact with infected persons. Preventative strategies include practicing good hygiene, avoiding crowded places, and wearing masks when necessary. The situation remains critical, and ongoing monitoring and public awareness are essential to mitigate the spread of this serious disease.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでの髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎：継続的な流行の中、公衆衛生対策の強化が求められている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。複数地域での同時流行報告と国際的な懸念が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではベトナムに加えアフリカ、日本、北米での流行報告があり、台湾での確認事例も言及されている。しかし対象国リストに含まれるのはベトナムのみ。髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は極めて高い致死率（未治療時10-15%）と急速な進行が特徴であり、WPROスクリーニング基準全5項目が該当する重大な事象。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Infection in Brazil: Recent trends and regional disparities in mortality
article.articleSummary: In Brazil, hantavirus has resulted in 189 deaths over the past decade, with significant regional disparities in case counts and fatality rates. The South region has reported the highest burden, with 238 cases and 77 deaths, translating to a case fatality rate (CFR) of 32.3%. In contrast, the Northeast has the fewest cases and deaths, but a notably high CFR of 66.6% from just three cases, two of which were fatal. Recent data indicates a decline in hantavirus cases and deaths from 2016 to 2025, although the disease remains a serious concern, particularly for rural workers exposed to wild rodent excreta. Infected individuals may develop hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome, characterized by severe respiratory symptoms, and there is currently no specific antiviral treatment available, which contributes to the disease's mortality.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのハンタウイルス感染症：死亡率の最近の傾向と地域的格差
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスは既知の風土病であり、過去10年間の後ろ向きデータ報告である。重症度（CFR 32-67%）と継続的な曝露リスク（野生げっ歯類への職業曝露）はWPRO基準に該当するが、情報が限定的であり、新規アウトブレイクの明示的な証拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事は10年間の後ろ向きデータサマリーであり、新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めたが、情報不足のため WATCH 判定。過去10年間の減少傾向が述べられており、急性の危機的状況を示唆していない。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus Cardiopulmonary Syndrome in Brazil: Current trends and regional impacts on public health
article.articleSummary: In Brazil, hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome has resulted in 189 deaths over the past decade, with significant regional disparities in case counts and fatality rates. The South region has reported the highest burden, with 238 cases and 77 deaths, translating to a case fatality rate (CFR) of 32.3%. In contrast, the Northeast has the lowest incidence, with only 3 cases and 2 deaths, but a striking CFR of 66.6%. Recent data indicates a decline in hantavirus cases and fatalities from 2016 to 2025, yet the disease remains a critical concern, particularly for rural workers exposed to rodent excreta. Symptoms of the syndrome include fever, shortness of breath, and tachypnea, with severe cases potentially leading to respiratory or cardiac failure. The absence of specific antiviral treatments exacerbates the mortality associated with this disease.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのハンタウイルス肺症候群：現在の傾向と公衆衛生への地域的影響
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス肺症候群はブラジルで過去10年間に189人の死亡が報告されており、農村労働者への継続的な曝露リスク、高い致命率（Northeast 66.6%）、そして動物由来病原体としての特性から、IHR基準2項目以上（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外の地域差）およびWPRO基準複数項目（重症度、長期曝露リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: ハンタウイルス肺症候群は動物由来感染症（zoonosis）であり、農村部での継続的な曝露リスクが存在。地域ごとの致命率のばらつき（Northeast 66.6% vs South 32.3%）は公衆衛生対応の強化が必要であることを示唆している。2016-2025年の事例数減少傾向は積極的であるが、特異的な抗ウイルス治療法の欠如が重大な懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: Listeria in China: Health warnings issued for food storage practices
article.articleSummary: In Shenzhen, Guangdong, a 79-year-old man developed pyogenic meningitis due to Listeria monocytogenes after consuming expired food items stored in his refrigerator. He exhibited symptoms including sudden weakness, high fever, neck stiffness, confusion, diarrhea, and urinary incontinence. Laboratory tests indicated elevated infection markers, and an MRI revealed bilateral frontal subdural effusions. The patient was diagnosed with acute bacterial meningitis and is recovering with treatment. Investigations suggest that the prolonged storage of food in the fridge, where Listeria can survive and multiply, was the source of infection. This case highlights the risks associated with consuming long-stored items, such as frozen meat, seafood, and dairy, and underscores the importance of proper food storage practices to prevent bacterial infections.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でリステリア症：食品保存慣行に対する健康警告が発行される
triage.triage_reason: 単一の散発症例（79歳男性の髄膜炎）であり、集団発生や広範な流行の兆候がない。ただしListeria monocytogenesは食品媒介性病原体であり、公衆衛生上の注意は必要。
triage.notes: 記事は単一の散発症例（深圳の79歳男性）の食品媒介性リステリア症髄膜炎を報告しており、集団発生やアウトブレイクの兆候はない。公衆衛生的には重症度がある（髄膜炎、脳脊髄液異常）が、流行可能性や国際的拡大リスク、管理能力の懸念は低い。情報が限定的であるため、WATCH判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Avian Influenza in India: Impact on poultry industry and local farmers
article.articleSummary: Navapur, Maharashtra, faces its third Avian Influenza outbreak since April 12, leading to significant losses in the poultry sector. The outbreak was confirmed on April 30, with a 1 km infected radius and a 10 km surveillance zone established. Over 200,000 birds have been culled, and approximately 800,000 eggs have been destroyed, alongside the disposal of more than 210 tonnes of feed. Key affected farms include Diamond and Tasleem Poultry Farms, with substantial losses reported. Farmers are struggling with low compensation rates, receiving only Rs 140 per bird, while actual costs can reach Rs 500. There is a growing call for vaccination against the H5N1 strain, which is currently not permitted in India for highly pathogenic avian influenza.

triage.headline_ja: インドの鳥インフルエンザ：家禽産業と地域農民への影響

triage.notes: マハラシュトラ州ナヴァプル地域は西インドの主要卵供給拠点で、4月12日以降3回目の発生。H5N1ウイルスが確認され、短期間での複数発生パターンは警戒が必要。インド国内ワクチン禁止政策も記載されており、管理可能性に課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: Angiostrongyliasis in Vietnam: Recent case highlights risks of parasitic infections
article.articleSummary: In Ho Chi Minh City, a 30-year-old woman developed eosinophilic meningitis caused by Angiostrongylus cantonensis, commonly known as rat lungworm. She experienced severe symptoms including headache, tinnitus, and photophobia, leading to an MRI that revealed multifocal nodular lesions in various brain regions. Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) analysis showed significant leukocytosis with eosinophilia, confirming the infection through PCR testing. The transmission route is linked to contact with infected rats or consumption of undercooked snails and contaminated vegetables. Treatment involved a combination of anti-inflammatory and antiparasitic medications, with close monitoring of liver function. After approximately two weeks, the patient's condition improved, allowing for discharge with outpatient follow-up. While the mortality rate for eosinophilic meningitis is around 2-3%, survivors may face long-term neurological issues. Preventive measures include proper food preparation and hygiene practices to reduce exposure to the parasite.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのアニサキス症：寄生虫感染のリスクを浮き彫りにする最近の事例

triage.notes: 広東住血線虫症（Angiostrongylus cantonensis感染）は東南アジアにおいて既知の風土病。本事例は個別症例報告であり、患者は治療により回復。ただし神経合併症のリスク（死亡率2-3%、神経学的後遺症）が指摘されている。追加症例が報告される場合、公衆衛生対応の必要性が高まる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in Brazil: Ongoing transmission risks amid fluctuating case counts
article.articleSummary: Paraná, Brazil, has reported 391 new dengue cases, bringing the total for 2026 to 3,232, with 2,674 of these being locally acquired infections. This increase follows a significant decline from the previous year, where over 53,000 cases were recorded in May 2025, highlighting a year-over-year reduction. Despite this decrease, health authorities emphasize the persistent risk of transmission, urging the public to maintain preventive measures. The circulation of all four dengue virus serotypes—DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, and DENV-4—poses additional challenges, as it raises the potential for future outbreaks. Contributing factors include climate conditions that support Aedes aegypti breeding, necessitating ongoing vigilance in controlling the mosquito population.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのデング熱：変動する症例数の中での継続的な伝播リスク

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus 71 in China: Monitoring rising cases and severe infections
article.articleSummary: Enterovirus activity is increasing in China, with neighboring regions like Vietnam reporting significant case numbers. The Taiwan CDC anticipates a peak season for enteroviruses, with a notable focus on the D68 strain, which has been linked to severe infections, including two cases of myelitis and encephalitis. Public health officials are urging vigilance, particularly among infants and schoolchildren, to identify severe symptoms early. Preventive measures such as keeping sick children at home and maintaining strict hand hygiene are being emphasized to mitigate the spread of the virus.

article.articleHeadline: Malaria in India: Weather patterns exacerbate vector-borne disease challenges
article.articleSummary: India is currently facing significant challenges with malaria, particularly in urban areas like Delhi, where erratic weather patterns are contributing to increased mosquito breeding. As of early May 2026, Delhi has reported 29 confirmed malaria cases this year, with five cases occurring in the past week. The recent wettest April in 18 years, combined with rising temperatures, has led to a surge in mosquito density, complicating efforts to control vector-borne diseases. The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has taken action by issuing over 16,000 legal notices to combat breeding sites, highlighting the urgency of the situation. The presence of Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, known for transmitting dengue, further complicates the public health landscape, as the city also grapples with 107 confirmed dengue cases, including 32 imported from other states. These developments underscore the need for effective vector control strategies to mitigate the impact of malaria and other mosquito-borne diseases in India.

triage.headline_ja: インドのマラリア：気象パターンが媒介動物感染症の課題を悪化させている

triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月現在のインドにおけるマラリア発生を報道。デリーで2026年初頭から29確定患者、過去1週間で5新規患者が報告されている。異常な気象パターン（過去18年で最も雨の多いアプリル）による蚊の繁殖増加が主要な懸念事項。市当局による16,000件以上の法的措置が実施されており、管理可能性についての懸念がある。同時にデングも流行中（107確定患者）でベクター管理の複合的課題が存在。

article.articleHeadline: African Swine Fever in Vietnam: Intensified response to combat virulent outbreak

The current outbreak is exacerbated by hot and heavy rainfall, which is accelerating the transmission rate and reducing the time from infection to death. Authorities have activated the highest level of outbreak response to mitigate the spread and minimize economic losses. While specific case and death counts have not been disclosed, the mobilization of resources and enforcement indicates a serious commitment to controlling the outbreak. The report lacks details on laboratory confirmations, infection sources, or the status of any imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚コレラのベトナムにおける拡大：激化する対応で猛威を振るう疾病に対抗

article.articleHeadline: Pneumococcus in Brazil: Monitoring meningitis case in Várzea Grande
article.articleSummary: An 11-year-old girl in Várzea Grande, Mato Grosso, has been hospitalized with confirmed Streptococcus pneumoniae meningitis, marking the first case of 2026 in the area. The local health department is actively monitoring the situation, having suspended classes and sanitized the school premises. Contact tracing is underway, urging those who had direct contact or exhibit symptoms to seek medical attention. The investigation revealed a prior flu-like illness and travel history to Cuiabá and Rondonópolis. Vaccination recommendations include meningitis C for infants and ACWY boosters for older children. Preventive measures such as masking and prompt medical care are emphasized to mitigate further spread.

article.articleHeadline: Zika in Brazil: New assessments aim to control mosquito populations
article.articleSummary: Sumaré's Health Department has initiated the second 2026 Larval-Density Assessment (ADL) to evaluate Aedes aegypti larvae, the vectors responsible for dengue, chikungunya, and Zika. This comprehensive survey covers neighborhoods including Nova Veneza, Dall’Orto, and João Paulo, focusing on identifying high-risk areas for targeted control measures. The latest Breteau index stands at 4.7, indicating a significant risk of an epidemic, with the Maria Antônia area showing the highest infestation levels. In 2026, Sumaré has reported 709 dengue notifications and 82 confirmed cases, with no fatalities. Preventive strategies include larviciding, community mobilization events, and educational outreach to residents about symptom recognition and prevention methods. Key recommendations for residents involve sealing water tanks, cleaning gutters, and eliminating standing water to reduce mosquito breeding sites. Community engagement is emphasized as crucial for effective disease prevention.

article.articleHeadline: Congenital Syphilis in Brazil: High incidence linked to inadequate maternal treatment
article.articleSummary: In Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil, 351 cases of congenital syphilis were reported in infants under one year in 2025, with an alarming 66 new cases confirmed in early 2026. The Municipal Committee for Prevention of Vertical Transmission (Semsa) highlights that 90.5% of mothers of affected infants received inadequate or no treatment. Late diagnosis is prevalent, with 55.5% of cases identified at delivery or curettage, emphasizing the need for early screening in the first trimester to facilitate timely treatment. From 2020 to 2025, over 11,000 syphilis cases were recorded among pregnant women, with a 30% increase noted in 2025 compared to 2024. Among the general population aged 13 and older, 63.7% of syphilis cases in 2025 were male. Semsa advocates for comprehensive testing during pregnancy, recommending screenings in each trimester and at delivery, with primary health units providing rapid tests and free treatment options.

article.articleHeadline: Ehrlichiosis in Brazil: Public health initiatives address animal welfare concerns

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2 in Brazil: Monitoring and vaccination efforts intensify amid cases
article.articleSummary: As of May 2, 2026, Brazil has reported 2,444 cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG), with a significant majority (1,509 cases or 61.7%) occurring in children under two years old. In response to the increasing demand for intensive care, 330 new ICU beds have been established across Pernambuco. The state is actively monitoring the epidemiological situation and managing bed availability through the Central Estadual de Regulação. Vaccination efforts are underway using a trivalent influenza vaccine that includes H3N2, with a target of 90% coverage among priority groups, including children, pregnant women, and the elderly. As of May 30, 554,330 doses have been administered, achieving approximately 25% coverage overall, with specific rates of 21.2% for children, 41.8% for pregnant women, and 25.8% for the elderly. The vaccination campaign aims to immunize over 3.7 million individuals before the seasonal window closes in August.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるヒトの豚インフルエンザA H3N2感染：監視と予防接種活動がケースの中で強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」と「異常/予想外」に該当（2つ以上）。2,444件の重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）症例が報告され、特に2歳未満の小児が61.7%を占めるなど、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのペルナンブーコ州における豚インフルエンザA H3N2による重症呼吸器症候群の増加を報告しています。ただし、対象国リスト内にブラジル（3469034）は含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列となります。感染症イベントの重要性は高いが、シグナルトリアージの地域範囲外のため、対象国以外として扱われます。

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1 in Brazil: Vaccination campaign targets vulnerable populations
article.articleSummary: As of May 2, 2026, Pernambuco, Brazil, has reported 2,444 cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG), with 1,509 (61.7%) of these cases occurring in children under two years old. The state is currently facing a critical situation, with 52 children and seven newborns awaiting ICU beds. In response to the increasing demand for respiratory care, 330 new ICU beds have been opened. The ongoing vaccination campaign aims to achieve 90% coverage among priority groups, including children, pregnant women, and the elderly, with a target of immunizing over 3.7 million individuals. As of May 30, 554,330 doses of the trivalent influenza vaccine, which includes protection against H1N1, have been administered, representing approximately 25% coverage. The campaign has seen varied uptake, with 21.2% of children, 41.8% of pregnant women, and 25.8% of the elderly vaccinated. The seasonal vaccination window extends until August, coinciding with an increase in influenza and other respiratory viruses.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおける豚インフルエンザA型H1N1感染：脆弱人口をターゲットとした予防接種キャンペーン
triage.triage_reason: ペルナンブーコ州で2,444件のSRAG症例が報告され、そのうち61.7%が2歳未満の小児であり、重症度が高く、ICU病床不足という深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められる。国内での流行の可能性と管理上の課題がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはペルナンブーコ州（ブラジル）での詳細な流行状況を述べており、同州は対象国リストに該当しないが、発生地域フィールドにBrazilが含まれており、記事主体もブラジル国内での流行対応であることから、Brazilのみを verified_locations に含めた。H1N1は既知病原体だが、2歳未満への高い罹患率（61.7%）と予防接種カバレッジの低さ（小児21.2%）が懸念される。

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのインフルエンザB：ワクチン接種キャンペーンが脆弱集団を対象に実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」（小児2歳未満61.7%、ICU逼迫）と「予想外」（2,444例SRAG報告）の2項目に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度（小児死亡・ICU需要）、長期曝露（8月まで継続予定）に該当。対象国ブラジルでの感染症イベントとして、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis A in Brazil: Outbreak linked to sanitation issues and flooding
article.articleSummary: Juiz de Fora, Minas Gerais, reports 729 confirmed Hepatitis A cases, accounting for approximately 70% of the state's total of 2026 cases, reflecting a staggering 1,925% increase from just 36 cases in 2025. The outbreak is widespread across the city, particularly in the Central and South regions. Contributing factors include recent floods and landslides, which have exacerbated sanitation challenges, alongside potential sexual transmission routes. A 60-year-old woman has died with suspected Hepatitis A as of April 30. In response, the Federal University of Juiz de Fora (UFJF) has initiated in-house testing to expedite results, processing 20-25 samples weekly. Vaccination efforts have been expanded to include pregnant women, individuals with liver disease, immunosuppressed persons, PrEP users, and unvaccinated individuals aged 11-39 who are close contacts of confirmed cases, with 10,000 vaccine doses dispatched to the city. Hepatitis A is primarily transmitted through the fecal-oral route, with symptoms including fever, fatigue, and jaundice.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのA型肝炎：衛生問題と洪水に関連した集団発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：729症例、死亡事例；異常性：前年比1,925%増加；国際拡大リスク：環境因子の継続）。WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当（異常/予想外、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA必要。
triage.notes: ジュイス・デ・フォーラ（Juiz de Fora）市、ミナスジェライス州での急速な流行拡大。729症例、死亡1名、前年比1,925%増。洪水・地滑りによる衛生悪化が主要因。連邦大学による検査体制強化、10,000用量のワクチン配備など対応進行中。A型肝炎の環境感染（糞口感染）経路が継続するため、長期曝露リスク高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue in India: Delhi faces increased cases amid erratic weather patterns
article.articleSummary: Delhi has reported 107 dengue cases this year, with 52 occurring in April alone, driven by erratic rainfall that creates ideal breeding conditions for the Aedes aegypti mosquito. This year's total already exceeds the April counts of previous years, including 130 cases by the end of April 2025, 32 in April 2024, and just 18 in April 2023. The current situation is compounded by 119 cases linked to infections from other states or untraceable addresses. In response, civic authorities have ramped up vector control efforts, conducting approximately 1.2 crore house visits, identifying 15,649 households with mosquito breeding, and issuing 16,261 legal notices. Prosecutions have reached 1,712, with fines exceeding Rs 50,000 in 358 cases, recovering over Rs 1 lakh. Authorities are focusing on preventing water accumulation in residential areas and promoting indoor preventive measures to combat the ongoing dengue threat.

triage.headline_ja: インドのデング熱：不規則な天候パターンの中、デリーで感染者の増加に直面
triage.triage_reason: デリーのデング熱患者数の季節的増加が報告されているが、現時点では深刻な健康危機の兆候や国際的拡大リスクの明確な証拠に乏しい。地域的な蚊媒介感染症の動向として注視が必要。
triage.notes: デリーにおけるデング熱患者数は2026年4月に急増し、前年同期比で著しく増加している。不規則な降雨がネッタイシマカの繁殖条件を助長しており、蚊媒介感染症の季節的パターンとして予想外の上昇を示している。当局による対応は迅速で、ベクター制御活動が強化されている。重篤患者や死亡の報告がないため、現在のところIHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」には該当しないと判断。ただし、複数州からの流入例や追跡不可能なケースがあることから、継続的な監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya in China: Travel warnings issued amid ongoing outbreaks
article.articleSummary: In 2024, China reported a concerning outbreak of Chikungunya, particularly in Foshan, prompting travel warnings from health authorities. The virus, primarily transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, has led to 112 confirmed cases globally, with most originating from India, alongside smaller numbers from Pakistan and Brazil. Symptoms include severe joint and muscle pain, fatigue, headaches, and nausea, with most patients recovering within one to two weeks. However, high-risk individuals may experience more severe complications affecting various systems. There is currently no specific antiviral treatment available, and prevention strategies emphasize the use of insect repellents. Vaccines, Ixchiq and Vimkunya, are accessible in the UK for travelers heading to affected regions, highlighting the importance of vaccination in mitigating risks associated with the virus.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のチクングニア熱：流行の継続に伴い渡航警告が発令
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱の中国での発生（フォーシャン）は確認されているが、記事は主に一般的な情報提供と英国での渡航警告に焦点を当てており、中国での流行規模や重症度に関する具体的情報が不足している。対象地域は確認されたが、国際的な初期拡大の兆候や深刻な公衆衛生影響の証拠が明確でない。
triage.notes: 記事は2024年の中国でのチクングニア熱発生を報告しているが、中国での具体的な症例数（記事では「112例が確認」と述べるが、これはグローバル数であり中国内の数ではない）や流行の現状に関する詳細が不足。フォーシャン（中国）での発生は確認されているが、IHR基準2つ以上該当しており、情報の追加確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19 in Thailand: Pediatric fatalities highlight urgent vaccination efforts
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 continues to pose significant risks in Thailand, particularly for children under five, who account for over half of pediatric deaths. Recent data indicates that on a single day, the country reported 20,052 new infections and 129 deaths, with a concerning 22% increase in fatalities week over week. As the Omicron variant drives infections, hospitals in Bangkok are preparing for an influx of severely ill children. In response, the government is expediting vaccination efforts for children aged five to 11, with plans to administer half-dose Pfizer boosters to those aged five to 17. Starting May 9, vaccination points in schools will facilitate this initiative, aiming to enhance immunity as the new school year approaches. Thailand's Covid-19 death toll ranks eighth globally, underscoring the urgency of addressing the ongoing health crisis and the potential for further mutations of the virus.

triage.headline_ja: タイにおけるCOVID-19：小児死亡率の上昇がワクチン接種努力の緊急性を浮き彫りにする
triage.triage_reason: タイにおけるCOVID-19の5歳以下の小児死亡が報告されており、重症度基準に該当する可能性がある。ただし、記事が既知の風土病としてのCOVID-19の継続的な動向報告であり、新規の公衆衛生学的脅威や異常性の証拠が不足しているため、情報確認が必要。
triage.notes: COVID-19はパンデミック既知疾患であり、タイの継続的な感染状況報告として評価。小児死亡の増加傾向とOmicron変異株の流行、政府による積極的なワクチン接種キャンペーンが報告されている。ただし、国際的拡大リスクやIHR通知基準の満たし方に関する情報が不足している。続報により更新推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus 71 in India: Mild seasonal outbreak affects young children
article.articleSummary: Recent reports indicate a notable increase in Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) cases among kindergarten and preschool children in Srinagar, with at least one school temporarily closing due to clustering. The outbreak, described as mild and seasonal, has been observed to recur in spring for the past five to six years, although occasional spikes are noted. The infection, primarily caused by coxsackievirus, spreads through the faeco-oral route, emphasizing the importance of hand hygiene and keeping symptomatic children at home. Symptoms include lethargy, fever, sore throat, and painful blister-like sores, typically lasting 5 to 7 days. While the disease is not deemed a major threat, its rapid spread in group settings has raised concerns among parents, prompting calls for proactive containment measures. No specific treatment exists, but fever can be managed with over-the-counter medications like paracetamol or ibuprofen.

triage.headline_ja: インド：エンテロウイルス71 - 軽度の季節性流行が幼い子どもに影響
triage.triage_reason: エンテロウイルス71による手足口病がインド（スリナガル）で報告されているが、軽度で季節性の既知パターンであり、国際的リスクは低い。ただし幼児集団での感染リスクと社会的関心があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: エンテロウイルス71は既知の季節性疾患で、過去5～6年春に周期的に発生している。軽度との記載あり。幼児施設での集団発生リスクと親の関心の高さがあるが、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。RRA進呼び水準には達していないと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1 in Brazil: FAO emphasizes urgent surveillance and response measures
article.articleSummary: As of March 2026, Brazil is facing a significant challenge with 188 reported outbreaks of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1, including 173 cases in wild birds, 14 in backyard flocks, and 1 in a commercial setting. The FAO has declared a nationwide zoosanitary emergency for 180 days to address the situation. The virus continues to spread across Latin America, with neighboring countries like Chile and Argentina also reporting outbreaks, prompting immediate export suspensions and biosecurity measures. The FAO stresses the importance of enhanced animal health surveillance, rapid testing of affected birds, and cross-sector collaboration to mitigate the risks associated with this virus. The ongoing threat underscores the need for robust interventions to protect both animal health and market stability.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの鳥インフルエンザA型H5N1人感染：FAOが緊急監視と対応措置を強調
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでH5N1の動物感染事例が188件報告され異常性がありWPRO基準複数該当するが、人感染の具体的な報告は見出しに示唆されるもサマリーには記載されていない。情報確認が必要なため経過観察段階。
triage.notes: 見出しは「Human Infection」を表示しているがサマリーは主に動物感染（野鳥173件、庭先養鶏舎14件、商業施設1件）に言及。人感染の詳細が不明なため、フルRRA前に記事本文確認が推奨される。2026年3月時点でのデータ。チリ・アルゼンチンへの拡大も報告。

article.articleHeadline: Meningoencephalitis in India: Outbreak linked to brain-eating amoeba raises alarm
article.articleSummary: Kerala, India is experiencing a significant outbreak of Naegleria fowleri, commonly known as the brain-eating amoeba, with 17 reported deaths and at least 96 infections over the past four months. Health officials indicate that the case fatality rate has decreased from nearly 99% to approximately 24% due to advancements in diagnosis and treatment. The infection, which leads to Primary Amoebic Meningoencephalitis (PAM), occurs when the amoeba enters the body through the nose, typically during freshwater activities. Symptoms manifest within 2 to 15 days and include severe headache, fever, vomiting, neck stiffness, and confusion, potentially progressing to coma. There is currently no vaccine or specific treatment available, making prevention crucial. Authorities recommend avoiding nasal exposure while swimming in freshwater, using nose clips, and ensuring the use of clean water for nasal rinses. Immediate medical attention is advised for individuals experiencing fever or headache after exposure to freshwater.

triage.headline_ja: インドの髄膜脳炎：脳を食べるアメーバによる流行が懸念を高める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・予想外の流行・国際拡大リスク）、高い重症度（死亡例・高い致命率）と長期曝露リスク、水環境媒介の流行可能性、およびケーララ州での集中的な流行報告。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ナエグレリア・ファウレリによる一次性アメーバ性髄膜脳炎（PAM）の集団発生。ケーララ州で過去4ヶ月間に17人の死亡、96人以上の感染報告。ワクチンおよび特異的治療法がなく、予防が重要。淡水での鼻腔曝露リスク。致命率が従来の99%から24%に低下したが、依然として重篤。環境媒介（淡水資源）の継続的なリスク。インド国内で医療対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Vibrio Vulnificus Infection in China: Urgent warnings issued for seafood handling safety
article.articleSummary: As of May 5, 2026, two severe cases of Vibrio vulnificus infection have been reported in Zhuhai and Shenzhen, highlighting the critical dangers associated with handling raw seafood. A 70-year-old woman in Shanghai developed a life-threatening infection after a fishbone punctured her finger, leading to necrotizing fasciitis and requiring amputation of her leg. She survived after two weeks in intensive care. In Shenzhen, a man suffered a similar injury, resulting in sepsis and multi-organ failure, though he has since stabilized after ICU treatment. The mortality rate for untreated infections is alarmingly high, exceeding 50% within 48 hours and potentially reaching 100% within 72 hours. Health officials emphasize the importance of preventive measures, including thorough cooking of seafood, wearing protective gloves, and seeking immediate medical attention for any wounds sustained while handling seafood.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のビブリオ・バルニフィカス感染症：海産物取扱いの安全性に関する緊急警告が発出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。高い致死率（未治療時48時間以内50%以上）と複数地域での同時発生により、シグナル認定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに明記されているZhuhai、Shenzhen、Shanghaiはいずれも中国内の都市。複数地域での同時発生、高い致死率（未治療時48-72時間で50-100%）、海産物関連の曝露継続、ヒト-ヒト感染なし。全スクリーニング基準に該当し、フルRRA進行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox in Democratic Republic of the Congo: Urban transmission raises concerns for public health response
article.articleSummary: Mpox is evolving towards urban transmission in Africa, indicating a significant epidemiological shift. Recent findings from the VAXPOX project at Institut Pasteur de Côte d'Ivoire highlight the virus's movement from rural to urban areas, with cases expanding geographically from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Nigeria. By late 2025, Madagascar is also expected to report cases. The transmission dynamics have diversified, revealing an emerging sexual transmission component alongside traditional animal-to-human spillover, particularly from rodents. This rapid spread necessitates urgent public health responses, as the virus reaches new countries with increasing speed. The VAXPOX initiative aims to utilize molecular testing, serology, and modeling to identify at-risk populations and develop effective prevention strategies, including vaccination, across multiple African nations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のポックス：都市部への感染拡大が公衆衛生対応に懸念を生じさせている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な地理的拡大、国際的な拡大リスク）に該当し、複数アフリカ国での急速な都市感染拡大、性的感染経路の出現という新しい疫学的シフトが確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とナイジェリア、マダガスカルでのポックス拡大が述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Bluedot APIの発生地域はDRCとなっており、記事の主題である農村部から都市部への感染拡大、性的感染経路の出現という新しい疫学的シフトはIHR・WPROs両方の複数基準に該当する重要なシグナル。VAXPOX プロジェクトによる国際的な対応の必要性が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: E. coli in Brazil: Sanitary alerts raise concerns over poultry exports
article.articleSummary: Recent reports indicate a significant sanitary alert triggered by the first batch of Brazilian chicken exported to Greece under the Mercosur–European Union agreement. Approximately 3 metric tons of frozen chicken were tested, revealing that around 80% of the samples were contaminated with Salmonella, prompting an investigation by Greek authorities. This incident has raised critical questions regarding food safety and the efficacy of export controls for Brazilian poultry. Experts emphasize that both Salmonella and E. coli pose risks in global animal-protein production, highlighting the importance of the Rapid Alert System for Food and Feed (RASFF) in managing noncompliant imports. While the Brazilian poultry sector faces scrutiny, stakeholders are cautioned against generalizing the entire industry based on this isolated incident. Further details, including the identity of the exporter and the total batch size, remain unclear, with the Brazilian Animal Protein Association (ABPA) expected to provide additional information.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのE. coli：家禽輸出に対する懸念の高まりが衛生警告を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 動物由来の食中毒菌汚染イベントであり、国際食品安全システム（RASFF）が関与する点で注視の価値がありますが、ブラジル国内での検査・追跡段階であり、ヒト感染症の直接的な流行を示す情報が不足しています。
triage.notes: 本イベントはブラジルの家禽製品からのSalmonella及びE. coliの検出であり、動物衛生・食品安全の問題です。記事の焦点はギリシャでの検査・警告（RASFF）であり、ブラジル国内での人間への感染症発生を示唆していません。公式な対象国リストにはブラジルが含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列です。IHR基準は2つ該当していますが、これは食品由来の製品汚染事案であり、感染症危機管理の対象外と判断します。

article.articleHeadline: Paratyphoid in Brazil: Sanitary alerts highlight food safety concerns
article.articleSummary: Recent reports indicate significant Salmonella contamination in a shipment of Brazilian chicken sent to Greece under the Mercosur–European Union agreement. Approximately 3 metric tons of frozen chicken were tested, with around 80% of the samples returning positive for Salmonella, prompting a sanitary alert and an ongoing investigation by Greek authorities. This incident marks the first consignment of Brazilian poultry to Europe under the new trade deal, raising critical questions about food safety and export controls. Experts emphasize that while this case is alarming, it should not be generalized to the entire Brazilian poultry sector, as Salmonella and Escherichia coli are recognized risks in global animal-protein production. The Brazilian Poultry Association (ABPA) is expected to provide further clarification, and the Rapid Alert System for Food and Feed (RASFF) is highlighted as a crucial mechanism for managing food safety compliance in international trade.

article.articleHeadline: Typhoid in Brazil: Food safety concerns amid international trade agreements
article.articleSummary: Recent reports indicate a significant sanitary alert in Greece following the first shipment of Brazilian chicken under the Mercosur–European Union agreement. Approximately 3 metric tons of frozen chicken were tested, revealing that around 80% of the samples were contaminated with Salmonella. This alarming finding has prompted Greek authorities to launch an investigation into the shipment, which is the first to arrive in Europe under the new trade deal. Experts emphasize the need for caution in generalizing the safety of Brazilian poultry, as Salmonella and Escherichia coli are recognized risks in global animal-protein production. The Rapid Alert System for Food and Feed (RASFF) is highlighted as a crucial mechanism for managing food safety and preventing noncompliant imports. As the Brazilian poultry industry faces scrutiny, stakeholders are awaiting further clarification from the Brazilian Animal Protein Association (ABPA) regarding the specifics of the shipment and the identity of the exporter.

article.articleHeadline: Foot And Mouth Disease in Brazil: Vaccination efforts ramp up to control outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Brazil is intensifying its vaccination campaign against foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) following recent outbreaks that have disrupted livestock production. The government aims to vaccinate 80% of the national herd by December to regain FMD-free status. As of now, over 2.5 million animals have been vaccinated in the initial phase, with additional millions of doses secured from Argentina and Brazil to meet the demand. The vaccination program is under state oversight, requiring farmers to comply with traceability and veterinary supervision. The recent outbreaks have affected multiple provinces, leading to restrictions on livestock movement and export markets. The government is also exploring subsidies and cost-sharing options to encourage farmer participation in the vaccination scheme, which is crucial for restoring the country's livestock health and international trade relations.

article.articleHeadline: Yellow Fever in Philippines: Emergency measures implemented to control transmission risk
article.articleSummary: On May 4, 2026, a health emergency was declared in Orellana, Ecuador, following the confirmation of a yellow fever case in the San Pablo community. The local Emergency Operations Committee has initiated extensive measures to contain the outbreak, including fumigation, elimination of mosquito breeding sites, and community clean-ups. Active epidemiological surveillance is being prioritized, particularly in urban areas, to prevent the disease from spreading from forested regions. Schools in the Río Coca area have temporarily shifted to virtual classes while disinfection and vector control efforts are underway. Health officials have emphasized the importance of vaccination, warning that unvaccinated individuals pose a higher risk of transmission. Yellow fever, a viral disease spread by mosquitoes, can lead to severe symptoms and complications, including liver and kidney failure. Vaccination remains the most effective preventive strategy against this disease.
